questions.stem: The saturation pressure of water at 30°C is 31.8 Torr. With an enclosure of V = 100 L, what is the maximum mass of water that can be vaporized at 30°C? Molar mass of water: 18 g. (R = 8.31 SI)
(Continued) What will then be the vapor pressure of a 2 g mass of water at 30°C in this same enclosure?
options: 17 Torr
24 Torr
14 Torr
27 Torr
21 Torr
questions.explanation: 2 g < 3.03 g, so it all vaporizes: P = 31.8 × 2/3.03 ≈ 21 Torr.

questions.stem: A particle undergoing ultracentrifugation, initially at 10 cm from the rotor axis, travels 2.5 cm during the first hour. How long will it take to reach the bottom of the tube located 18 cm from the rotor axis?
options: 2 h 38 min
3 h 21 min
2 h 06 min
1 h 54 min
3 h 12 min
questions.explanation: ln(x/x₀) is proportional to t: t = 1 h × ln(18/10) / ln(12.5/10) ≈ 2.63 h ≈ 2 h 38 min.
